name: Mayborn Building

decisions: Metro has 6 footprints here where OSM has one; compared against their union, OSM kept as one building (roof parts split it)
OSM and Metro differ (corner p95 1.67 m); OSM is as close or closer to the LiDAR edge (0.64 vs 0.76 m): OSM used
LiDAR roof edge lies a uniform 0.60 m outside the walls: logged as roof overhang, not corrected
5 edge(s) more than 0.3 m off the LiDAR edge moved to it: 2.61 m edge outward 0.74 m; 7.64 m edge outward 0.59 m; 24.42 m edge outward 0.79 m; 2.5 m edge outward 1.25 m; 8.24 m edge outward 1.14 m

material_rule: walls and vertical roof steps brick_red (guess); roof faces flatter than 6 deg roof_flat, steeper roof_slate unless the Metro 2026 ortho color is clearly green (roof_copper) or orange-red (roof_tile); base concrete

collider.kind: one non-convex static triangle mesh (LoD2 shell without base cap)

footprint.reference: osm outline; LiDAR edge for moved corners
